data.name: Eimaan
data.gender_notes: Eimaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic word 'Eimaan' signifies faith, trust, and belief. It is derived from the verb 'Amana' which means 'to believe'. The name Eimaan carries the meaning “Faith, trust, belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Eimaan usually hope their child will grow to embody faith, trust, belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of steadfastness in faith and trust in Allah
data.etymology: Eimaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith, trust, belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eimaan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: ایمان
